r.s: PHP5 Resolver library used to communicate with a DNS server.
r.d:
Provides (roughly) the same functionality as Net_DNS, but using PHP5 objects, exceptions for error handling, better sockets support.
This release is (in most cases) 2x - 10x faster than Net_DNS, as well as includes more RR's (including DNSSEC RR's), and improved sockets and streams support.
r.n: - changed the role for the README.md file to doc - parse the resolv.conf options line; right now I just support the timeout and rotate options. - the options values only work if you set the new option use_resolv_options to true; this is to keep backwards compatibility. - added support for RFC 6594; support for SHA-256 and ECDSA in the SSHFP resource record. - added the SMIMEA resource record; this just extends the TLSA record. - added the AVC resource records; this just extends the TXT record. - added error and EDNS0 defines for DNS Cookies (RFC7873) - added EDNS0 defines to the lookup class - dropped the Net_DNS2_Packet::formatIPv6() function; this was deprecated in v1.1.3 - re-wrote the Net_DNS2::expandIPv6() function. Based on testing, the new version is about twice as fast.
